title: Kanban drag-drop loses card position

agentWork.notes: Fixed kanban drag-drop revert: handleDragEnd no longer re-splices cross-column moves (compared against drag-origin status), corrected off-by-one index math in both reorder routines, suppressed click-after-drag that opened the story modal, added onDragCancel. Verified with tsc.

description: When dragging a card from Doing to Review, the card reverts to its old position after drop.
stepsToReproduce:
1. Open Kanban
2. Drag card from Doing to Review
3. Card jumps back
